envelope.description: The outbox band, its actions and the shortcut hint in the webview

body.title: The outbox band, its actions and the shortcut hint in the webview
body.summary: In the chat webview shell (chat-panel.ts renderShell): an #insrc-outbox band above the input bar, present only when the queue is on, drawn from 'outbox' with textContent (summary line with ahead / running / waiting-on, rows with place, first line, attachment count, error, and Cancel / Resend / Dismiss as role=button spans with keyboard activation), styled with the chat's theme variables in its rounded style. With the queue on, doSubmit no longer marks the turn running (the host's 'turn-running' does), and the hint '⌘/Ctrl+Enter to queue' is shown beside the message box while a turn runs.
acceptanceChecks: The shell has #insrc-outbox and the hint only when the queue is on
An 'outbox' message draws its rows and summary line (ahead, running, waiting on); an empty view hides the band
Each action posts its outbox-* message with the row's seq

With the queue on, submitting does not mark the turn running; the hint shows while a turn runs and hides after; without the queue, submitting still marks running locally and the existing tests for it stand

tests.name: chat shell: the outbox band and the queue shortcut hint are present only with the queue; an outbox message draws its rows and summary and each action posts its seq; with the queue a submit does not mark the turn running
